cross_paths.name: edge_energy
cross_paths.note: phi^T L phi of the same network (G_DD reference form)

contacts.body: B0 (electron-blocking companion, as all existing decks): Si bottom y = 1.2 um: psi = psi_b0 and ZERO normal electron flux (no electron contact equation). In a code with ohmic-only contacts: zero electron surface recombination velocity.
contacts.drain: ohmic, far edge x = L + l_w, 0 <= y <= h_w: psi = V_T asinh(N_net/(2 n_i)) + V_D; phi_n = V_D
contacts.faces_below_well: far edges for y > h_w: homogeneous Neumann for psi and zero normal electron flux
contacts.gate: oxide top y = -t_ox over 0 <= x <= L: psi = V_G + psi_b0 (V_FB = 0)
contacts.oxide_triple_points: the Si/SiO2 nodes at x = -l_w and x = L + l_w are tied to the adjacent contact psi
contacts.source: ohmic, far edge x = -l_w, 0 <= y <= h_w: psi = V_T asinh(N_net/(2 n_i)); phi_n = 0

doping.profile: N_A uniform plus donors N_D(x, y) = 1e20 f_x(x) f_y(y): f_x = 0.5 erfc((x - x_c)/(sqrt(2) sigma)) + 0.5 erfc(((L - x) - x_c)/(sqrt(2) sigma)), x_c = -sqrt(2) sigma erfcinv(2 N_A/N_D) (N_D = N_A at x = 0 and x = L); f_y = 0.5 erfc((y - h_w)/(sqrt(2) sigma_y)); fully analytic, no doping step on a mesh line

geometry.contact_extent_note: source/drain contacts cover 0 <= y <= h_w; on a tensor mesh the realized extent is the depth line nearest h_w (this mesh: contact_extent_um_this_mesh). Its effect on G_DD/G_SD/G_DB is <= 6.5e-9 relative (benchmark/wp2/results/contact_extent_check.json, amendment A4).
geometry.coordinates: x along the channel (source side first), y depth into Si (y = 0 at the Si/SiO2 interface, oxide at -t_ox <= y <= 0)

physics.gate_convention: gate contact psi_gate = V_G + psi_b0 (V_FB = 0; no work-function difference, no oxide charge)
physics.gate_work_function: phi_m = chi_Si + 1.0362 V (equals the p-substrate work function, so V_FB = 0); E_c - E_i = 0.56 eV
physics.holes: not part of the observable: report the electron component of each terminal current, or hold holes at equilibrium p = n_i exp(-psi/V_T) (pre-registration section 2.5); the body is ohmic for holes in B0 and B1
physics.mobility: constant mu_n (field-independent); zero-bias network edge conductance c_e = q mu_n EdgeCouple EIL n0 B(Delta)
physics.oxide: SiO2, no fixed or trapped charge, no carriers
physics.psi_reference: intrinsic Fermi level (psi = 0 at n = p = n_i)
physics.units: 2-D simulation; currents in A/cm and conductances in S/cm per unit device width

mesh.generator: endprobe deck-R maps (phase3.c6.rprobe.lateral_nodes, phase3.c7.endprobe.depth_map, oxide_map(t_ox, 5)); refinement factor sqrt(2) per level; each rectangle split into two triangles (node_lines_file has the exact node lines and rules); box integration, Scharfetter-Gummel edge currents (DEVSIM 2.11.2)

notes: Two-terminal companion of the three-terminal case (electron-blocking body B0, the boundary data of every existing deck). Not separately pre-registered for reference quality; no tolerance is established, so only same-mesh (bracket) scoring applies.

G0_S_per_cm.path: -I_S of the two-terminal network (source side, cancellation-free); G_DD = G_SD = G0 with body B0
